

// package main




fn helper( ) -> (()) {
    
        

print!("helper");



    
}
fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let _unit = helper()
;


let highest = std::cmp::max(2, 3)
;



let text = String::from("rust");



let length = text.len()

;



assert_eq!(highest, 3); assert_eq!(length, 4);




let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {





tokio::spawn(

std::future::ready(())
);





});



    
}
